meaning.en: Simple past tense and past participle of overpass.
meaning.vi: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ phân từ của overpass.

sentences.en: I walked through an overpass over the road.
sentences.vi: Tôi đi qua một cây cầu vượt bên đường.

sentences.en: Economic shrinking has finally been overpassed now.
sentences.vi: Sự suy giảm kinh tế cuối cùng đã được khắc phục.

sentences.en: They deflated the tires slightly to allow the truck to drive under the overpass.

sentences.en: His action won't be overpassed in the studies.

sentences.en: They built an overpass that overbuilt another one.
